basic_details.job_title: AWEIL Senior Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

Applications are accepted only as a hard copy by speed post or courier, addressed to Director (HR), Kanpur, and must be received by 12 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About the Organisation
content_sections.text: AWEIL is a Scheduled 'A' Defence Public Sector Undertaking under the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, with its Corporate Headquarters at Kanpur. It was incorporated under the Companies Act 2013 on 14 August 2021 and commenced business on 1 October 2021. It is mainly engaged in the manufacture and supply of weapon systems, small arms, tank gun articles and ammunition components, and has eight production units in various states.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit the application in the prescribed format as a hard copy. The format is attached to the notice and can be downloaded from www.aweil.in or ddpdoo.gov.in. Send it by speed post or courier to: Director (HR), Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited, Ordnance Factory Kanpur premises, Kapli Road, Kanpur UP -208009 Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST "Sr. Manager-IT Web"" clearly on the envelope. Only a hard copy of the application is acceptable. Attach 2 self-attested recent passport photographs, with the full name written on the back for identification. Paste one photograph (4.4 cm x 5.8 cm) in the space provided on the form; the second is to be attached, not pasted. Fill in all relevant details such as qualifications, experience, percentage of marks, email address, mobile number, address for correspondence and AADHAR/PAN number. For enquiries, the letterhead gives the numbers 0512-2245889, 0512-2245794 and 0512-2245878 and the email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: AWEIL has notified one post of Sr. Manager- IT Web, shown as 01 (UR) in the notice, on full-time contract basis. Educational qualification: B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science/Information technology, or Master of Computer Applications (MCA), or M.Sc. in Computer Science/Information technology, or NIELIT 'B' label, from a University/Institution recognized by the Government of India, preferably having various certifications in the relevant field. Experience: 05 years post qualification experience in web site maintenance and development in a Department of Government of India, a Department of State Governments, a Public Limited Company, a Private Limited Company or an Autonomous body. Nationality: the candidate must be a citizen of India. Strong proficiency in PHP and working knowledge of Java for back-end logic. Solid grasp of HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript/jQuery. Experience with MySQL or relational database administration and query optimization. Familiarity with Git version control, FTP/SFTP, and cPanel or cloud server environments. Strong debugging skills using browser developer tools and server error logs. Exposure to a government/PSU or defence office IT environment is desirable. Validating and implementing software solutions including web responsive applications (Web, Mobile); ability to understand the architecture of existing systems and implement greenfield architecture; taking part in requirements review meetings and requirement analysis. Not more than 45 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Total emoluments: consolidated Rs. 1,10,000/- (One Lakh Ten Thousand Only) per month, which shall be enhanced 10% per year. No other allowances shall be admissible. Leave: 12 days casual leave at one casual leave per month on pro-rata basis, which can also be availed as half day. Accommodation: company quarter will be provided if available, with necessary deduction as per Company Rules. Initial period is 02 years, extendable on yearly basis for up to 04 (02+1+1) years from the date of initial appointment, subject to appraisal of performance and on need basis. The appointment is purely temporary and on contract basis. AWEIL can end the services with 1-month notice or one month's pay in lieu; the candidate leaving must give three months' notice or pay three months' salary in lieu. The selected candidate must sign a contractual agreement in the prescribed format. The contract does not confer any right or claim of extension/absorption in the Company. Place of posting is the AWEIL Corporate Office. The person may be deputed for official work to any unit of AWEIL or Govt. offices/Departments, and may be transferred to another unit/office of AWEIL based on requirement. Working hours follow the office timing of AWEIL HQ. If required, the person may be asked to attend office on Saturday or other holidays without additional compensation. New Labour codes apply to newly engaged contract employees.

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Sr. Manager- IT Web Job Description
content_sections.text: Routine Maintenance: regular website updates, system patches, database optimizations and scheduled backups. Debugging and Troubleshooting: diagnose and resolve front-end and back-end errors, broken links, performance bottlenecks and server-side issues. PHP and Java Support: maintain, update and refactor existing code bases written in PHP and Java. Security and Monitoring: monitor website traffic and server health, implement security updates, patch vulnerabilities, and support clearance of various certificates required for hosting the web site. Database Management: monitor and tune MySQL/SQL queries used by the PHP and Java applications. Front-end Assistance: update HTML, CSS and JavaScript elements during routine content or layout changes. Collaboration: coordinate with hosting providers, project managers and internal teams to deploy updates safely. Another job in the IT field may be assigned in addition to web site maintenance and development.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: 2 self-attested recent passport photographs with full name on the back. Self-attested copies of documents supporting age (Birth Certificate / 10th Class Certificate). Self-attested copies of qualification and experience certificates, and other documents specified in the notification. Candidates working in Govt./Public Sector should route the application through proper channel, showing mode of recruitment, present grade and present scale of pay, or submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview. At the interview, candidates are to bring the documents in original plus two self-attested copies (if physical mode).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on the basis of Educational Qualification, Experience and performance in a personal interview, conducted by a duly constituted selection committee. The ratio between the number of vacancies and the number of eligible candidates called for interview shall be 1:10. Candidates to be called may be sorted from the recommended list. For posts where experience is essential, sorting is on total experience acquired. Where experience is not mandatory, it is on marks in the minimum qualifying exam. Any specific preference may be considered for scrutiny. These criteria are subject to change, if justified, with the approval of CMD/AWEIL. Candidates called for interview must produce original documents on educational qualifications and experience for verification. If identity is in doubt, documents are not produced or do not match, the candidate will not be allowed to appear and the candidature is treated as cancelled. AWEIL's decision on mode of selection, eligibility conditions and shortlisting for interview is final and binding.
